body:
We discussed it a bit with @vvo, and here what came out (not final):

* Each widget should have a default template that does the very minimal markup for the behavior, but no specific styling
* Each widget should let the user define its own template so they have complete power on how to render/style it if they want to go deeper

We should also aim to provide widgets that looks good out-of-the-box. For that, I suggest each default template should, at least, provide a `t-` class on the top wrapper element (for theming). We will provide a `theme.css` file along with our widgets that users can include to have the same look'n'feel than on the instant search.

Users that want to simply tweak the display can use this file as a base for their rewrite, while more advanced users can simply change the template.

WDYT?
